title: Linux containment step 3: the Landlock launcher — apply the ruleset in a child and exec the real command

tasks.title: Add/adjust tests and make them pass
read the spike FFI reference, ADR-0010 and specification §4.4; produce the porting notes and the proposed grant set
tests for the grant model: AC1 profiles, AC2 refusals, deny-list-under-a-granted-root
rework landlock.ts to the grant model (handle read rights, grant roots, check the deny list)
tests for layer selection in wrap.ts and the resolved layer in detect.ts (AC3, AC8)
implement landlock-exec.ts: FFI applier, PATH resolution that refuses, execve, exit-status mapping
live enforcement tests with negative controls (AC4, AC5, AC6, AC7), skipped-with-reason below ABI 3
wire the Linux branch: wrap.ts layer choice, detect.ts layer field, adapter and callers unchanged
prebundle landlock-exec to a single .js in the build step and resolve its path for dev and installed runs
record the layer that ran in the run receipt and in sandbox status, from the parent (AC10)
measure the benign $HOME grant set against real commands; record each granted entry as a reviewed widening
decide and record the newer-kernel ABI-clamp position and the environment-forwarding position
correct every document this flow's own changes falsify (os-sandbox surface docs, wiki, guide)
quality gate and review-orchestrator until green (AC11)
